verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Bitwarden's integrated TOTP generation, authenticator sync and importing codes from other apps. Nothing in the pack shows search, folders or groups, or service icons for organizing TOTP tokens. The Public API's 'collections, groups' refers to organization member management, an adjacent feature that does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away
